treatment: JSON reserialized with relative/sanitized path strings; full sourceTreeLines omitted with separate text digest. Numeric samples, SHA256, MVID, full commits, results and closure flags unchanged.

payload.Scope: Focused archival value operations only. Constructed fixtures establish neither native admission nor graphics/gameplay fidelity.
payload.ConstructedFixture: fixed seed; 1024 funded and1024 unfunded archival facts; raw granted ledger and nullable full funding included for even shot IDs; constructed AcceptedFire lane is a value field, not evidence of native admission
payload.Measurement: 30 serial raw batches after8 warmup batches per case. Wall/CPU percentile values are batch totals, not per-operation or per-frame tails. Process CPU includes all process threads. Caller allocated bytes uses GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread and excludes prepared fixture setup except begin_fresh_setup. No sample filtering, forced collection, or outlier removal. Quantile interpolation over30 samples is descriptive and does not establish high-percentile tails.
